richiami.difetto: Vehicles may be fitted with cylinder blocks which are missing a cooling nozzle. If a cooling nozzle is missing, the piston may not be cooled down sufficiently, potentially causing it to weaken, warp or break. This could lead to sudden engine failure, causing power transmission loss. This could also trigger thermal runaway leading to fire and injuries of the passengers. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 13/04/2026

traduzione.difetto: I veicoli possono essere dotati di blocchi cilindrici che mancano di una boccola di raffreddamento. Se una boccola di raffreddamento è assente, il pistone potrebbe non essere raffreddato adeguatamente, provocando la sua debolezza, deformazione o rottura. Ciò potrebbe causare il fallimento improvviso del motore, con perdita della trasmissione di potenza. Potrebbe anche scatenare un surriscaldamento termico che porta a incendi e lesioni ai passeggeri. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla approvazione e sul controllo del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: On certain Peugeot vehicles the Automatic Emergency Braking Assist  telltale fails to illuminate if the front camera is blocked. No AEB warning  telltale meaning no warning light appears in the instrument cluster. An  additional pop-up appears for around 10 seconds at each key on/key off  (Driving Assistance Sensor Blind: clean sensor see User Manual). The  Automatic Emergency Braking system is operating in a degraded mode but  remains functional due to radar support.
richiami.rimedio: To rectify this issue we will update the Vehicle System Management software
richiami.titolo: VSM software missing AEB telltale in case of blind camera.

A missing nozzle means the piston may not be adequately cooled causing it to weaken deform or break and leading to sudden engine failure resulting in a loss of power and in the worst‑case scenario a thermal incident.

richiami.titolo: Cooling spray nozzle potentially missing

richiami.difetto: The DV5R engine may experience a loss of power due to slippage of the water pump pulley. This slippage can cause misalignment of the timing belt, potentially resulting in engine shutdown. The sprocket of the water pump pulley may detach from the shaft, which can lead to the loss of parts on the road and increase the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 11/03/2026

Questo scivolamento può causare un'allineamento errato della cinghia di distribuzione, potenzialmente provocando lo spegnimento del motore. Il pignone del polso della pompa di raffreddamento potrebbe staccarsi dall'albero, il che può portare alla perdita di parti sulla strada e aumentare il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

In wet conditions, the insufficient clearance and possible contact between these components can lead to water infiltration, causing an electric arc, that could trigger a thermal event, such as overheating, which may lead to fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

The non-conformity of the round shape on the cone of the common rail may cause the nut to loosen, resulting in the possibility of fuel leaking between the nut and the thread, leading to fuel vapours and fuel flow into the hot exhaust system. This may lead to a fire under the bonnet. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

richiami.difetto: The aluminium of the EBS valve block may not fully cast around the valves. This can lead to an internal leak of brake fluid (from one or more of the 12 valve seats) resulting in a reduction of the fluid level and the deactivation of stability control due to damage to the pressure sensor. The brake fluid could come into contact with the printed circuit board and result in the deactivation of all control functions (including the anti-lock system and electronic brake force distribution). The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 14/04/2025

traduzione.difetto: L'alluminio del blocco della valvola EBS potrebbe non essere stato completamente gettato intorno alle valvole. Ciò può provocare una perdita interna di fluido frenante (da una o più delle 12 sedi valvole), causando una riduzione del livello del fluido e la disattivazione del controllo della stabilità a causa del danno al sensore di pressione. Il fluido frenante potrebbe entrare in contatto con la scheda elettronica, provocando la disattivazione di tutte le funzioni di controllo (compresi il sistema antiscivolo e la distribuzione elettronica della forza frenante). Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: The evaporative emission of the vehicle is too high, causing excessive pollution. The hydrocarbon (HC) level is above the legal limit prescribed for evaporative emissions testing (Type 4). The vehicles do not comply with anti-pollution standards. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions from light passenger and commercial vehicles (Euro 5 and Euro 6) nor with the requirements of the Directive 2007/46/EC on the approval of vehicles and trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 06/10/2023
richiami.titolo: The evaporative emission of the vehicle is too high, causing excessive pollution.

traduzione.difetto: L'emissione evaporativa del veicolo è troppo elevata, causando un'eccessiva contaminazione. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento relativo all'approvazione di tipo dei veicoli a motore con riguardo alle emissioni dei veicoli a motore leggeri e commerciali (Euro 5 e Euro 6) né i requisiti della Direttiva 2007/46/EC sull'approvazione dei veicoli e dei rimorchi, e dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: It has been established that the high pressure fuel rail pipes on the engine have not been torqued to the correct specification. This can result in poor sealing of the rail which can cause as fuel leak onto the engine. If the vaporised fuel comes into contact with a hot engine component there can be a risk of an engine bay fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all the affected vehicles and retorque the high pressure fuel rail pipes.

richiami.difetto: An internal fault with the wiper motor could cause it to stop working. In some rare cases the windscreen wipers may stop working while in operation.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check the manufacturing date of the wiper motor and add a supplementary earth wiring harness if necessary.
richiami.titolo: WIPER MOTOR MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: On the affected vehicles the rear screen seal may not conform which could lead to water ingress in the boot and poor ageing of the seal. In very rare cases the rear screen could detach.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to remove and refit the rear screen.
richiami.titolo: REAR SCREEN COULD DETACH

richiami.difetto: It is possible that a leak can occur between the injector spill rail connection and the plastic fuel return pipe. This can cause leakage of fuel which can either pool on the engine cylinder head and then become deposited onto the road surface where it could cause a skid risk to other motorist or if the fuel comes into contact with extremely hot engine components an exhaust manifold for instance it is possible that an under bonnet fire could ensue.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the sealing of the fuel return pipe connection on each injector and if necessary replace the injectors as well as the fuel return pipes.
richiami.titolo: RISK OF UNDER BONNET FIRE

richiami.difetto: Over time partial wear of the gearbox control harnesses may occur due to contact with surrounding components. Gear selection may be affected as a result of electrical faults in some rare cases including the lighting of the warning lamp on the instrument panel and the driveability of the vehicle may be compromised.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the condition of the gearbox control harness and where necessary fit additional protection.
richiami.titolo: INABILITY TO CHANGE GEAR

richiami.difetto: The steering column link bolt which retains the steering wheel to the steering column may not have been tighten to the correct specification. This can result in a gradual increase in movement between the steering wheel and shaft with an associated rattle. This should identify the issue to the driver however if the driver does not heed this warning then the steering control of the vehicle could be reduced.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required re-torque the steering column link bolt.
richiami.titolo: POTENTIAL FOR REDUCED STEERING CONTROL

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles connectors intended to supply the electric front seats fitted to some versions are not used and are located under the rear footwell carpets. richiami.difetto: It has been identified that within the mechanism of the accelerator pedal there is a friction lever which interacts with a sliding surface. Over time and under certain conditionsthe contact surfaces may generated excessive friction and latterly the movement of the accelerator pedal. This over time and under certain conditions will result in the accelerator pedal becoming intermittently more difficult to push; or slower to return. In rare instances the accelerator pedal can remain in the partially depressed position.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have a reinforcing plate fitted within the accelerator pedal mechanism which will ensure continued correct functionality.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the main engine fuse box is not to the correct specification. This can result in operating faults or the failure of certain equipment.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fuse box replaced.
richiami.titolo: FUSE BOX MAY CAUSE EQUIPMENT OPERATIONAL FAILURES

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the main engine fuse box is not to the correct specification. This can result in operating faults or the failure of certain equipment.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fuse box replaced.
richiami.titolo: FUSE BOX MAY CAUSE EQUIPMENT OPERATIONAL FAILURES

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the main engine fuse box is not to the correct specification. This can result in operating faults or the failure of certain equipment.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject fuse box replaced.
richiami.titolo: FUSE BOX MAY CAUSE EQUIPMENT OPERATIONAL FAILURES

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that; with the engine switched off the side indicator repeaters do not operate when the parking lights are on.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the relevant operating software upgraded.
richiami.titolo: INDICATOR SIDE REPEATERS MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: It has been identified thatthere is a risk that subject vehicles will unnecessarily enter a reduced power mode which would result in severely reduced engine power output.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have a new version of software downloaded to the engine management computer.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY LOOSE POWER

richiami.difetto: On the subject vehicles it has been identified that there is a risk of the engine stalling during very sporty driving conditions.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the engine ECU software upgraded.
richiami.titolo: RISK OF ENGINE STALL

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a problem may arise with the steering mechanism which can result in hardness whilst manoeuvring.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the steering mechanism checked and lubricated. The mechanism will be replaced if found to be damaged. At the same time certain vehicles will have key components reinforced against the ingress of water. Thus preventing operating faults in the long term.
richiami.titolo: STEERING MAY BECOME STIFF

richiami.difetto: A deterioration of the brake assistance may occur because it is possible for the brake servo valve to leak oil which can damage the membrane of the brake servo.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to change the valve and the vacuum circuit pipe connecting the vacuum pump to the brake servo.
richiami.titolo: OIL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: Some vehicles may have been fitted incorrect specification flexible brake hoses which if not checked and replaced could lead to a brake failure.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles for inspection of the flexible brake hoses and replacement if found to be out of specification.
richiami.titolo: REDUCED BRAKING EFFICIENCY

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on the specified vehicles a fault may develop with the brake vacuum pump. This can result in hardening of the brake pedal with an attendant loss of braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.
richiami.titolo: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on the specified vehicles a fault may develop with the brake vacuum pump. This can result in hardening of the brake pedal with an attendant loss of braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.
richiami.titolo: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on the specified vehicles a fault may develop with the brake vacuum pump. This can result in hardening of the brake pedal with an attendant loss of braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.
richiami.titolo: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on the specified vehicles a fault may develop with the brake vacuum pump. This can result in hardening of the brake pedal with an attendant loss of braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.
richiami.titolo: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on the specified vehicles a fault may develop with the brake vacuum pump. This can result in hardening of the brake pedal with an attendant loss of braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.
richiami.titolo: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the operation of the  ABS/ESP braking unit may be affected by the ingress of water.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles to reinforce the resistance of the ABS/ESP unit to water.
richiami.titolo: POTENTIAL LOSS OF ABS AND ESP FUNCTIONS

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the earthing terminal for the electrical power assisted steering assembly may require reinforcing. This is necessary in order to provide the correct electrical supply to the power steering assembly and to prevent possible loss of steering assistance. In any case the vehicle's steering capacity is not altered.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the power steering earth connection reinforced as necessary.
richiami.titolo: POTENTIAL LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the heat shield which protects the exhaust system may contact one of the rear brake hoses. In extreme situations this may cause leakage within a brake circuit which would be represented by extended brake pedal travel.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be checked for heat shield to brake hose contact and if necessary the shield will be adjusted. The brake hose will be replaced if rubbing contact has been made.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE.

richiami.difetto: The window controls could remain active for 45 seconds after switching off the ignition even after opening one of the doors.  This could allow unintentional use of windows which could result in an injury.  Additionally it contravenes anti-theft regulations.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles and install upgrades software.
richiami.titolo: WINDOW CONTROLS COULD REMAIN ACTIVE AFTER SWITCHING OFF THE IGNITION.

richiami.difetto: In the notified vehicles equipped with Electronic Stability Programme (ESP) there is a possibility of leakage which can cause short circuit or fire.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective action taken by the importer · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: In the notified vehicles equipped with Electronic Stability Programme (ESP) there is a possibility of leakage which can cause short circuit or fire.

richiami.difetto: The windscreen wiper wiring may be contacted by the wiper mechanism. If there is prolonged contact between the wiring and mechanism there is a risk of the wiper function failing.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary reposition the wiring.
richiami.titolo: WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the alternator terminal wiring could be positioned too close to the exhaust heat shield. Under extreme conditions this proximity could result in an electrical short circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will checked and the subject terminal repositioned as necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility of a non conformity of the engine cooling motor fan unit which can result in a failure of the unit or exceptionally in local overheating that can result in combustion of the unit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace the motor fan unit.
richiami.titolo: RISK OF FIRE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the welding operation on the sleeve end panel of the handbrake system may not have been correctly carried out.  This could result in greatly reduced handbrake efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject assembly strengthened.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE ASSEMBLY MAY BECOME INSECURE

richiami.difetto: On subject vehicles the fitting of the diesel high pressure delivery pipe may be constricted. Should this be the case a fuel leak may occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject pipe checked and changed if found to be fitted incorrectly.
richiami.titolo: FUEL LEAK MAY OCCUR

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on certain vehicles a fault may be present on the diesel fuel circuit return pipe at the location of the pressure sensor.In the manufacture of the pipe an excess of material resulted in a reduction of the pipe's internal diameter therefore restricting the fuel flow and a risk of a diesel leak from the fuel connector.
richiami.rimedio: Subject vehicles will have the diesel fuel delivery pressure in the injection pump checked. This will check the conformity of the pipe which in the case of nonconformity will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: It has been identified on a small number of vehicles that the spacer for the front right-hand seat belt fixing bolt may have been incorrectly fitted. It is therefore possible that in time this could result in the fixing for the assembly becoming insecure.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the fitting of the spacer checked for compliance with the specification. If found to be necessary the trim will be repositioned and the assembly re-tightened to the correct torque.
richiami.titolo: FRONT RIGHT HAND SEATBELT FIXING BOLT MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of injury. The possible loss of gear selection where it is not possible to engage the gear may lead to breakdown of vehicle or loss of control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective action by the producer.  · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The product poses a risk of injury.

richiami.difetto: On the vehicles concerned the lower fixing for the left hand front seat belt may be of an incorrect specification. This may lead to the fixing becoming loose.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the fixing checked and corrected as necessary.
richiami.titolo: SEAT BELT FIXING MAY LOOSEN

richiami.difetto: The quality of the welding at the suspension mounting reinforcement plates may not be to specification.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the welding. Where necessary take corrective action to ensure that the reinforcement plate welding operation has been correctly completed.
richiami.titolo: REAR AXLE FIXING BOLTS MAY BECOME LOOSE

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the engine may stall when lifting your foot off of the accelerator immediately after high speed usage of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download a new piece of software to the engine ECU.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY STALL

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the engine may stall when lifting your foot off of the accelerator immediately after high speed usage of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to download a new piece of software to the engine ECU.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY STALL

richiami.difetto: The seat belt locking action may not be as fast as it is designed to be.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that may be affected to check the date of manufacture of the seat belts and where necessary replace the seat belts.
richiami.titolo: SEAT BELT BRACING ACTION MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: The seat belt locking action may not be as fast as it is designed to be.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that may be affected to check the date of manufacture of the seat belts and where necessary replace the seat belts.
richiami.titolo: SEAT BELT BRACING ACTION MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: Braking assistance could be adversely by freezing of moisture that may accumulate in the vacuum circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that may be affected and fit a separate air vent complete with filter to each electro valve fitted to the vacuum circuit.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: Braking assistance could be adversely by freezing of moisture that may accumulate in the vacuum circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that may be affected and fit a separate air vent complete with filter to each electro valve fitted to the vacuum circuit.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
richiami.rimedio: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
richiami.rimedio: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
richiami.rimedio: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
richiami.rimedio: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: Due to a potential fault in the engine management system an internal engine fuel leak via the injectors may occur following switching off. This would result in the engine failing to restart due to excess fuel being present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
richiami.rimedio: To address the issue recalled vehicles will receive an engine management download.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: The incorrect fixing of the left hand curtain airbag can lead to incorrect deployment in the case of a left hand side impact or frontal impact with a high degree of angular bias to the left.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and re-fix the airbag correctly.
richiami.titolo: AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INADVERTENTLY

richiami.difetto: Incorrect manufacture of the rear bench seat bolsters could in the case of an impact hinder the deployment of the rear lateral airbags.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit modified seat bolsters.
richiami.titolo: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS DESIGNED

richiami.difetto: It is necessary to check the fitting of the pedal box transfer bar levers on (RHD only). In rare cases where the return bar lever is faulty the braking efficiency could be affected.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the transfer bar checked and replaced if found to be faulty.
richiami.titolo: BRAKES MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: It is necessary to check the fitting of the pedal box transfer bar levers on (RHD only). In rare cases where the return bar lever is faulty the braking efficiency could be affected.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the transfer bar checked and replaced if found to be faulty.
richiami.titolo: BRAKES MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: It is necessary to check and reinforce the sealing of the electrical connections for the ABS system. As under certain conditions the repeated entry of salt water into this connection could cause short circuits which may lead to a fire within the engine compartment
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have numerous checks carried out and repairs completed dependent upon what is found.
richiami.titolo: CORROSION OF ELECTRICAL CONNECTION WHICH COULD CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility of untimely triggering of the starter motor which if the vehicle has been left in gear could result in the vehicle jerking forward when the starter motor engages.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles and down load new software for the intelligent servo control unit.
richiami.titolo: STARTER MOTOR MAY OPERATE INADVERTENTLY

richiami.difetto: Under certain circumstances a brake pipe may chafe on the turbo charger air intake securing clip. In extreme situations the wear caused could lead to leakage within a brake circuit and the illumination of the red brake warning light.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be checked for the chafe condition and if necessary the turbo air intake securing clip will be relocated. The affected brake pipe will also be changed if it displays any sign of wear.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE CIRCUIT MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: It is necessary to reinforce the sealing of electrical connections for the steering system electro pump assembly. As under certain conditions the repeated entry of salt water into this connection could cause short circuits which may lead to a fire within the engine compartment.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have numerous checks carried out and repairs completed dependent upon what is found.
richiami.titolo: RISK OF FIRE IN ENGINE COMPARTMENT

richiami.difetto: In countries where salt is used extensively on the roads the paint sub layer on certain springs produced over a specific manufacturing period shows very little resistance to corrosion. This can in exceptional circumstances cause a front suspension spring to break with the attendant risk that the spring could contact the tyre.
richiami.rimedio: To prevent an occurrence of this type likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time a suspension cup will be fitted on each front side of the vehicle to prevent a failed spring from making contact with the tyre.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION SPRING MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: Some cases have been found where inadequate drainage of water condensing from the air conditioning system has caused water to run under the carpet. This in turn may lead to the airbag warning light coming on or in extreme cases lead to airbag systems malfunctioning.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected for modification of the drainage tube and the anti return valve.
richiami.titolo: AIRBAG SYSTEM MAY MALFUNCTION

richiami.difetto: The airbag Electronic Control Unit (ECU) is incorrect to specification this reduces the number of impact configurations taken into consideration when activating the airbags. So an airbag may not deploy in as many advantageous situations.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag ECU.
richiami.titolo: AIRBAG ECU IS NOT TO SPECIFICATION

richiami.difetto: The original software may generate excessive oscillation of the motorised throttle valve which in extremely rare cases causes the failure of its throttle stop. This results in the engine operating in safety mode with a possible reduction in braking assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the ECU and either perform a download or replace the ECU.
richiami.titolo: EXCESSIVE OSCILLATION OF THE THROTTLE VALVE

richiami.difetto: There is a risk of a manufacturing non conformity on the fuel injection diesel return pipe. This may lead to the possibility of fuel seepage.
richiami.rimedio: As a preventive measure likely to be affected vehicles will have the pipe replaced additionally the pipe will be fitted with protective sleeves.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE SEEPAGE ON THE DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE

richiami.difetto: There is a risk of a manufacturing non conformity on the fuel injection diesel return pipe. This may lead to the possibility of fuel seepage.
richiami.rimedio: As a preventive measure likely to be affected vehicles will have the pipe replaced additionally the pipe will be fitted with protective sleeves.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE SEEPAGE ON THE DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE

richiami.difetto: There is a risk of a manufacturing non conformity on the fuel injection diesel return pipe. This may lead to the possibility of fuel seepage.
richiami.rimedio: As a preventive measure likely to be affected vehicles will have the pipe replaced additionally the pipe will be fitted with protective sleeves.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE SEEPAGE ON THE DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the handbrake mechanism is not to the correct specification and as a result there is a possibility that under certain conditions the vehicle could roll away.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect and test the handbrake mechanism. If necessary replace the brake pads and re-adjust the handbrake cable as specified.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE MECHANISM MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION

richiami.difetto: The possibility exists that the starter motor wiring loom has been positioned incorrectly. In consequence there is a risk that this could cause a short circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and correctly fit the wiring loom.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT THE STARTER MOTOR WIRING LOOM IS INCORRECTLY POSITIONED

richiami.difetto: It has become necessary to check the front brake hoses and improve their protection. In extreme cases wear on the hose caused by chafing against the wheel arch could cause a brake fluid leak. The presence of which would initially illuminate the red warning lamp on the dashboard.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and check the condition of the front brake hoses. If found to suffering a chafe situation the hoses will be changed. If not the hoses will be checked for orientation and fitted with an additional protective device.
richiami.titolo: IMPROVE THE PROTECTION OF FRONT BRAKE HOSES

richiami.difetto: There is a risk that the lower swivel joint on the front suspension has not been sufficiently tightened.
richiami.rimedio: Check the mounting and tightness of the joint if found out of specification replace the joint.
richiami.titolo: CONCERN THAT THE LOWER AXLE SWIVEL JOINT WAS NOT TIGHTENED CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: The original engine software may cause erratic operation of the motorised throttle body.  This could  in rare extreme cases cause the throttle stop to break.  This will cause the engine to revert to limp home mode which possible may cause a reduction in braking assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Install updated software in the engine ECU.
richiami.titolo: FAILURE OF THE THROTTLE STOP COULD LEAD TO A REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: The original engine software may cause erratic operation of the motorised throttle body.  This could  in rare extreme cases cause the throttle stop to break.  This will cause the engine to revert to limp home mode which possible may cause a reduction in braking assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Install updated software in the engine ECU.
richiami.titolo: FAILURE OF THE THROTTLE STOP COULD LEAD TO A REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: It is a possibility that vehicles may not be correctly fitted with a rear seat anchorage point strengthener. If the strengthener is not fitted the vehicle will not comply with the defined retention criteria in the case of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be inspected for the presence of the seat anchorage strengthener. In cases where it is not in place the vehicle will be returned to specification.
richiami.titolo: THE VEHICLE MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY FITTED WITH A REAR SEAT ANCHORAGE POINT STRENGTHENER

richiami.difetto: The possibility exists that the weld points on the chassis rear side members may not have been made correctly. With the result that in the case of an impact the vehicle would not comply with the energy absorption criteria.
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled for checking of the subject welds. If it is found that the welds are not to specification Product Service should be contacted.
richiami.titolo: WELD POINTS ON REAR SIDE CHASSIS MEMBERS MAY HAVE NOT BEEN MADE CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: The software may cause erratic operation of the motorized throttle which may result in breakage of the throttle stop. This can result in the engine reverting to limp home mode with a possible reduction in braking assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Subject vehicles will be recalled and the condition eradicated by carrying out an ECU download.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF ERRATIC OPERATION OF THE MOTORIZED THROTTLE BODY

richiami.difetto: The spoiler mounting on the rear tailgate may in certain cases have some weak points and cause some noise.This may even lead to the loss of the spoiler
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace the 4 spoiler fixing bolts and fit two safety straps
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT THE REAR SPOILER MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: The accelerator pedal may not return correctly.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the accelerator pedal end stop.
richiami.titolo: THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY NOT RETURN CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the EGR support bracket may break and cause a short circuit which may stop the engine.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace EGR bracket.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT EGR SUPPORT BRACKET MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility of defective components in the heater blower which could cause a short circuit and loss of ventilation of the passenger compartment and in an extreme condition could set fire to the wiring harness.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace heater blower module
richiami.titolo: RISK OF FIRE - HEATER BLOWER MODULE

richiami.difetto: The handbrake adjustment system may be unreliable which will reduce its efficiency under certain conditions.
richiami.rimedio: Check adjust and/or replace the brake shoe mechanisms.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED.

richiami.difetto: Possible non-conformity of the rear suspension triangles could in rare cases of stress lead to their deformation.
richiami.rimedio: Fit new right and left side lower suspension triangles.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DEFORMATION OF REAR SUSPENSION

richiami.difetto: It is necessary to protect the battery supply circuit to prevent any possible risk of an electrical short circuit
richiami.rimedio: Fit a replacement battery negative cable fitted with a maxi fuse also fit protective felt to the aluminium section of the air conditioning pipes to insulate them from the battery positive cable.
richiami.titolo: PROTECTION OF THE BATTERY SUPPLY CIRCUIT.

richiami.difetto: It is necessary to exchange the two clevis pins on the brake pedal system to avoid any loss of braking.  Peugeot have experienced a limited number of incidents where one of the pins has not been locked properly during fitting.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the potentially affected vehicles and replace the two clevis pins on the brake pedal system.
richiami.titolo: SERVICE BRAKE LINKAGE MAY BECOME DISCONNECTED

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that water may ingress into the airbag electronic control unit (ECU) compartment.  This may cause premature deployment of the airbag.
richiami.rimedio: Seal the airbag ECU compartment.
richiami.titolo: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the electric sliding doors may open whilst the vehicle is in motion.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a replacement electronic control unit to the door.
richiami.titolo: ELECTRICAL SIGNAL COULD NEUTRALISE THE SLIDING DOOR SAFETY LOCK

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the connections for the side airbags and seat belt pre-tensioners may have been inverted on the connectors for the airbag ECU.  In the case of an impact there is a risk that the incorrect side airbag could be triggered.
richiami.rimedio: Check and if required change over the wires concerned in the airbag connector.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE INCORRECT WIRING OF SIDE AIR BAGS AND SEAT BELT PRETENSIONERS

richiami.difetto: Due to an incident during the vehicle manufacturing process there may be cuts in the side wall or tread of one or both of the tyres on the right hand side of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Examine the tyres fitted to the vehicle and replace any that are found to be cut.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF CUTS IN TYRES.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the wiring loom may be damaged as a result of contact being made between components in the heater blower and gear lever.  This may result in a short circuit and failure of the heater.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a  protector and an additional grooved sleeve.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF WIRING LOOM

richiami.difetto: Internal tyre tread may have been damaged during fitting which could lead to a loss of pressure.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace all five tyres.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO TYRE DURING FITTING

richiami.difetto: Rear bench seat in third row may not lock in place and tip forward during harsh deceleration
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and modify routing of check strap.
richiami.titolo: REAR BENCH SEAT MAY NOT LOCK IN PLACE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the connections for the side airbags and seat belt pre-tensioners may have been inverted on the connectors for the airbag ECU.  In the case of an impact there is a risk that the incorrect side airbag could be triggered.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and reverse the wires concerned in the Air Bag Connector
richiami.titolo: INCORRECT WIRING OF LATERAL AIRBAGS AND SEAT BELT PRETENSIONERS

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the lower engine mounting point is weak.  This may lead to significant engine vibration which in turn could result in the right hand drive shaft coming adrift.
richiami.rimedio: Examine and replace the engine support yoke where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE SUPPORT YOKE WELD MAY FAIL.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that water may collect within the casing of the cooling fan and in a limited number of cases an under-bonnet fire.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a modified cooling fan assembly.
richiami.titolo: WATER MAY ENTER COOLING FAN  - RISK OF FIRE.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that water may collect within the casing of the cooling fan and in a limited number of cases an under-bonnet fire.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a modified cooling fan assembly.
richiami.titolo: WATER MAY ENTER COOLING FAN  - RISK OF FIRE.

richiami.difetto: The automatic gearbox control wiring loom may become pinched. This may make it possible to start the engine whilst the car is in gear.
richiami.rimedio: Check whether the wiring loom is being pinched. Repair and reposition the loom where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT VEHICLE COULD BE STARTED WITH GEAR SELECTOR IN ANY POSITION

richiami.difetto: The front left hand anti-roll bar linkage may contact and chafe the brake pipe when turning the wheels to full left lock.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect and where necessary reposition the left front brake pipe.
richiami.titolo: FRONT BRAKE PIPE MAY CHAFE ON ANTI ROLL BAR

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the brake fluid is not to the correct specification.  this over a period of time could adversely affect the brake performance.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the hydraulic fluid in the brake and clutch operating circuits.
richiami.titolo: INCORRECT SPECIFICATION BRAKE FLUID

richiami.difetto: There is a risk that the tyres may have been damaged during fitting onto the wheel rim at the factory.
richiami.rimedio: Replace all five tyres.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO TYRES

richiami.difetto: The front shock absorber lower yoke might not be to the correct specification. As a consequence the yoke may fracture and cause a deterioration in the vehicles road holding.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and examine the front shock absorber lower support for cracks. Fit new shock absorbers where necessary.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER CONCERN

richiami.difetto: There is a risk that the secondary handbrake cable could become detached from the rear brake mechanism causing the handbrake to become ineffective.
richiami.rimedio: Check that the handbrake cable is correctly located in the rear brake mechanism.  If it is not a new cable will be fitted.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE CONCERN

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the steering column cowling may move out of alignment causing the ignition switch to foul on the steering cowling and possibly stick in the start position.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check and where necessary replace the steering column clamp.  The cowling unit is replaced on all vehicles recalled.
richiami.titolo: IGNITION KEY MAY FOUL STEERING COLUMN COWLING

richiami.difetto: Key operation in the steering lock ignition switch may become stiff or could seize.  An ignition switch seized in the start position could result in a starter motor burn out.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the complete steering lock assembly.
richiami.titolo: IGNITION SWITCH FIRE RISK

richiami.difetto: The front right hand lower suspension arm may not be to specification.  As a consequence it may deform under certain impact loads.
richiami.rimedio: Check the identification markings on the suspension arm and replace where necessary.
richiami.titolo: FRONT RIGHT HAND LOWER SUSPENSION ARM MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION

richiami.difetto: In adverse wet weather conditions water may enter the engine management solenoid valve operating circuit. This could result in engine operating problems and a reduction in power assistance to the brake pedal if the water enters the brake vacuum circuit via the solenoid valves.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to examine and if necessary replace the engine management solenoid valves with ones sealed against the ingress of water.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE PLUS ENGINE OPERATING PROBLEMS.

richiami.difetto: In adverse wet weather conditions water may enter the engine management solenoid valve operating circuit. This could result in engine operating problems and a reduction in power assistance to the brake pedal if the water enters the brake vacuum circuit via the solenoid valves.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to examine and if necessary replace the engine management solenoid valves with ones sealed against the ingress of water.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE PLUS ENGINE OPERATING PROBLEMS.

richiami.difetto: In adverse wet weather conditions water may enter the engine management solenoid valve operating circuit. This could result in engine operating problems and a reduction in power assistance to the brake pedal if the water enters the brake vacuum circuit via the solenoid valves.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to examine and if necessary replace the engine management solenoid valves with ones sealed against the ingress of water.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE PLUS ENGINE OPERATING PROBLEMS.

richiami.difetto: In adverse wet weather conditions water may enter the engine management solenoid valve operating circuit. This could result in engine operating problems and a reduction in power assistance to the brake pedal if the water enters the brake vacuum circuit via the solenoid valves.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to examine and if necessary replace the engine management solenoid valves with ones sealed against the ingress of water.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKING ASSISTANCE PLUS ENGINE OPERATING PROBLEMS.

richiami.difetto: There is a risk that the lower attachment on the front and rear left hand seat belts could be loose.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles to check and if necessary tighten the seat belt fixings.
richiami.titolo: SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE CONCERN.

richiami.difetto: There is a risk that the lower attachment on the front and rear left hand seat belts could be loose.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles to check and if necessary tighten the seat belt fixings.
richiami.titolo: SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE CONCERN.

richiami.difetto: The driver and where fitted passenger air bags may not deploy correctly in an accident due to a fault in the electronic control unit (ECU).
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles conduct a diagnostic check on the ECU and rectify or replace as appropriate.
richiami.titolo: FRONT AIR BAG(S) MAY NOT DEPLOY.

richiami.difetto: There is a possible risk of the lower seat belt mounting bolt on the front left hand seat being loose or misaligned.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check installation of bolt - if correctly installed check tightness of bolt if bolt is not located correctly replace with supplied bolt.
richiami.titolo: THE LEFT HAND FRONT SEAT LOWER SEAT BELT MOUNTING BOLT MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: Incorrect specification passenger airbag internal module.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles replace airbag.
richiami.titolo: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY

richiami.difetto: The camshaft drive belt may fail before the recommended replacement interval of 72000 miles. This could result in a complete loss of engine power without warning.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement camshaft drive belt.
richiami.titolo: FAILURE OF CAMSHAFT DRIVE BELT

richiami.difetto: The camshaft drive belt may fail before the recommended replacement interval of 72000 miles. This could result in a complete loss of engine power without warning.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement camshaft drive belt.
richiami.titolo: FAILURE OF CAMSHAFT DRIVE BELT

richiami.difetto: There is a risk of internal cracking of the 4-way brake pipe unions ( non- ABS models) or the 2 x 4 - way brake pipe unions ( ABS models). This could result in a gradual loss of brake fluid and reduced braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace the four way brake pipe unions.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID

richiami.difetto: There is a risk of internal cracking of the 4-way brake pipe unions (non- ABS models) or the 2 x 4-way brake pipe unions (ABS models). This could result in a gradual loss of brake fluid and reduced braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace the four way brake pipe unions.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID

richiami.difetto: Brake servo vacuum pipe may become damaged due to chafing on engine wiring harness. This could result in a loss of braking assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles replace and reposition the servo vacuum pipe to avoid further chafing.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE SERVO VACUUM PIPE

richiami.difetto: The fuel tank could be insecure due to the cross member carrying the fuel tank rear fixings not being to the correct specification.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to carry out a modification to the fuel tank rear mountings.
richiami.titolo: FUEL TANK MOUNTINGS

richiami.difetto: Brake pedal relay lever may fracture and adversely affect the operation of the braking system.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement relay lever.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE PEDAL RELAY LEVER

richiami.difetto: Incorrect specification rear suspension arm pivot fixing bolts could fail under arduous operating conditions possibly resulting in the rear wheel locking.
richiami.rimedio: Recall potentially affected vehicles examine the pivot fixing bolts and renew with ones of correct specification where necessary.
richiami.titolo: REAR SUSPENSION FIXING BOLTS

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the front stub axle lower ball joint fixing may have been incorrectly machined which may result in separation of the stub axle from the ball joint/lower suspension arm.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to check and if required replace the left and right stub axles which will be carried out free of charge.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION CONCERN

richiami.difetto: Brake vacuum pump drive pin may fail as a result of premature wear. This could result in a loss of power assistance at the brake pedal.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to fit a quality assured replacement drive pin to the brake vacuum pump.
richiami.titolo: VACUUM PUMP DRIVE PIN

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility of an open circuit in the connector on the front seat belt pretensioner harness. This may cause flashing of the airbag warning light and a loss of the pretensioning function in case of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the front seat pretensioner harness.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER HARNESS

richiami.difetto: An incorrect left hand drive shaft may have been fitted. The shaft could separate from the gearbox on a sharp bend or during excessive suspension deflection.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a correct specification left hand drive shaft where necessary.
richiami.titolo: DRIVESHAFT MAY DETACH FROM GEARBOX

richiami.difetto: Brake vacuum pump drive pin may fail as a result of premature wear. This could result in a loss of power assistance at the brake pedal.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to fit a quality assured replacement drive pin to the brake vacuum pump.
richiami.titolo: VACUUM PUMP DRIVE PIN

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the front stub axle on one or both sides of the vehicle may have been incorrectly machined. This could result in excessive wear the lower ball joint becoming displaced and the collapse of the suspension.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check and if necessary replace both front stub axles.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION MAY COLLAPSE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the front stub axle on one or both sides of the vehicle may have been incorrectly machined. This could result in excessive wear the lower ball joint becoming displaced and the collapse of the suspension.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check and if necessary replace both front stub axles.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION MAY COLLAPSE

richiami.difetto: Possibility of unintentional deployment of either side air bags
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace both side air bag control units.
richiami.titolo: UNINTENTIONAL DEPLOYMENT OF SIDE AIR BAGS

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that fuel may seep from fuel filter housing due to external corrosion. A fire risk may exist.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace aluminium fuel filter with a plastic fuel filter.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM FUEL FILTER

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the nuts securing the support for the brake pedal assembly may be loose or missing with a risk of disengagement of the support and loss of braking control during hard braking.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and if required replace or tighten the nuts on the pedal return support.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE PEDAL ASSEMBLY MAY DISENGAGE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that there is a risk that the rack to subframe bolts have been overtightened with the possibility of the bolts and/or rack mounting points cracking/breaking. This could lead to noise/vibration or loss of steering accuracy.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles examine the steering rack mounting bolts. Renew the mounting bolts/nuts and replace the steering rack if the mounting points are cracked or broken.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE INSECURITY OF STEERING RACK

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that there is a possibility that the inner edge of the alloy wheels may have been deformed when fitting the tyres. This may result in the wheel breaking.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check the wheels for damage with a special gauge and renew where necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF ROAD WHEEL

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that there is a possibility of premature wear of the handbrake lever ratchet leading to potential disengagement of the handbrake.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and where necessary replace the original handbrake with a quality assured unit.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE INADVERTANT RELEASE OF HANDBRAKE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility of seepage from the rear brake pipe unions above the spare wheel. This will lead to the need for periodic topping up or illumination of the brake fluid low level warning lamp and in extreme circumstances the effectiveness of the foot brake could be impaired.
richiami.rimedio: Recall potentially affected vehicles to check and if required replace the brake pipes.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FLUID SEEPAGE FROM REAR BRAKE CIRCUIT

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that there is a possibility that the front suspension lower ball joint pinch bolt has been incorrectly tightened leading to potential collapse of the front suspension.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all potentially affected vehicles to check and if required tighten the pinch bolt.
richiami.titolo: POTENTIAL COLLAPSE OF FRONT SUSPENSION

richiami.difetto: Possibility of starter motor harness fouling on harness support bracket which may lead to damaged wiring and a potential short circuit or breakdown of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles examine harness for damage and repair where necessary. Reposition harness clear of obstructions.
richiami.titolo: WIRING HARNESS CHAFING

richiami.difetto: The main underbonnet harness may become damaged through chafing on the scuttle panel. This could result in stalling and loss of electrical functions.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a protective sleeve to the main wiring harness to prevent chaffing.
richiami.titolo: LOSS OF ELECTRICAL FUNCTIONS

richiami.difetto: As a result of incorrect material specification the brake servo diaphragm may fail. This would result in extra pedal effort and an increase in stopping distance.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the brake servo replaced with a quality assured unit.
richiami.titolo: FAILURE OF BRAKE SERVO

richiami.difetto: An incorrect load sensitive rear brake compensator may have been fitted to some boxer vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Potentially affected vehicles are being recalled to have the compensator examined. Vehicles equipped with an incorrect unit will have this replaced with the correct type.
richiami.titolo: INCORRECT BRAKE COMPENSATOR

richiami.difetto: An incorrect load sensitive rear brake compensator may have been fitted to some 306 models.
richiami.rimedio: Potentially affected vehicles are being recalled to have the compensator examined. Vehicles equipped with an incorrect unit will have this replaced with the correct type.
richiami.titolo: INCORRECT BRAKE COMPENSATOR

richiami.difetto: The load sensitive compensator on the braking system may be incorrectly set.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the compensator checked and where required adjusted in accordance with the manufacturers specification.
richiami.titolo: SETTING OF BRAKE COMPENSATOR

richiami.difetto: Fuel may seep from the fuel filter pipe unions.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the filter pipe unions examined and secured where required.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE SEEPAGE OF FUEL

richiami.difetto: It is possible for the ignition switch harness to foul on the steering column coupling. This could lead to short circuiting and electrical malfunction.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles are being recalled for the harness to be repositioned.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF WIRING HARNESS

richiami.difetto: On some 406 models the steering column wiring harness may foul on the steering column and lead to electrical malfunction.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles are being recalled to Peugeot dealers to have the subject harness repositioned.
richiami.titolo: THE STEERING COLUMN HARNESS MAY FOUL ON STEERING COLUMN

richiami.difetto: Due to possible defective sealing there is a risk of seepage from the fuel feed pipe where it connects to the injector rail on some 405 models.
richiami.rimedio: All vehicles potentially affected by this campaign are being recalled to Peugeot dealers for the fitment of a modified clip to the fuel feed pipe.
richiami.titolo: FUEL FEED PIPE SEEPAGE

richiami.difetto: Due to possible defective sealing there is a risk of seepage from the fuel feed pipe where it connects to the injector rail on some 405 models.
richiami.rimedio: All vehicles potentially affected by this campaign are being recalled to Peugeot dealers for the fitment of a modified clip to the fuel feed pipe.
richiami.titolo: FUEL FEED PIPE SEEPAGE

richiami.difetto: Some passenger seat pedestals may have been incorrectly attached to the vehicle floor. This could result in the seats detaching from the floor in an accident situation.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have modifications to the seat pedestals carried out. The modified pedestals will be secured by bolts through the steel section of the floor.
richiami.titolo: SECURITY OF PASSENGER SEATS

richiami.difetto: The rotary connector on the air bag system can fail and cause interruption to the air bag electrical supply. This may prevent the air bag deploying in the event of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for a modification to the air bag electrical system.
richiami.titolo: AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY

richiami.difetto: There is a risk of accelerator cable breakage due to cable kinking when the accelerator pedal is released suddenly.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified accelerator pedal.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE BREAKAGE OF ACCELERATOR CABLE

richiami.difetto: The welding attaching the front suspension lower wishbone bracket to the subframe may be suspect. In extreme conditions this could affect the driving quality of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check the integrity of the subject welding. Where this is not to specification the subframe attachment will be reinforced by bolting or in extreme cases the subframe will be changed.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE BRACKET

richiami.difetto: The injector retaining clamps may not have been correctly tightened. This could result in leakage of fuel from around the injectors.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and ensure that the injector clamp bolts are tightened to the manufacturers specification.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE PETROL LEAKAGE

richiami.difetto: The driveshaft retaining nuts may slacken due to defective peening.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check the driveshaft retaining nuts for security. Any nut showing evidence of defective peening will be renewed and secured as per the manufacturers instructions.
richiami.titolo: DRIVESHAFT NUTS MAY SLACKEN

richiami.difetto: The driveshaft retaining nuts may slacken due to defective peening.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check the driveshaft retaining nuts for security. Any nut showing evidence of defective peening will be renewed and secured as per the manufacturers instructions.
richiami.titolo: DRIVESHAFT NUTS MAY SLACKEN

richiami.difetto: Due to manufacturing defect the handbrake can be inadvertently released from its applied position.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original handbrake assembly with a quality assured unit.
richiami.titolo: INADVERTENT RELEASE OF THE HANDBRAKE
